name: TOPA
motto: NOTHING SUPERNATURAL — ONLY NATURE NOT YET UNDERSTOOD.
purpose: Give every JANUS agent a common evidence-bounded method for unusual, anomalous, paranormal-labeled or extraordinary reports: neither dismiss the unknown nor promote an interpretation beyond the evidence; convert the report into explicit competing hypotheses, falsification routes and source-bound observations.

formalization_status.note: TOPA was first recovered as a conceptual JANUS research branch and canonicalized in Genesis v1.0. A concurrent canonical case corpus then appeared in janus-meta-registry and is adopted here as lineage without treating documented calls as truth of the claims made.

registry_lineage.boundary: A documented broadcast occurrence establishes that a claim was made in the sourceable segment; it does not establish the physical truth of the claim.

closed_belief_loop_alarm.name: CLOSED_BELIEF_LOOP_WARNING
closed_belief_loop_alarm.trigger: No possible observation, test or source result is named that could lower confidence in the favored interpretation.
closed_belief_loop_alarm.effect: Block promotion beyond hypothesis/context until a disconfirming route exists.
closed_belief_loop_alarm.does_not_mean: The claim is false; only that the current belief loop is not falsifiable.

kenshi_binding.effect: TOPA assessments may be handed off through the Kenshi blackboard, but each Scout keeps its identity, observation provenance and independent evidence boundary.

microkernel_binding.JOB_INTAKE_KERNEL: Accept anomalous reports as questions or work claims without pre-adjudicating truth.
microkernel_binding.ADMISSION_KERNEL: Admit bounded tests, source checks and competing hypotheses rather than desired conclusions.
microkernel_binding.COHORT_KERNEL: Seal the test set before result quality is known.
microkernel_binding.DRAIN_KERNEL: Let admitted checks finish; preserve failures and overflow.
microkernel_binding.EVIDENCE_KERNEL: Enforce source-bound positive claims and source independence.
microkernel_binding.POLICY_MEMORY_KERNEL: Persist negative, falsified and unresolved outcomes without erasure.

claim_ceiling: TOPA is an epistemic and engineering protocol. It does not assert that any paranormal, anomalous, mythic, oracle-derived, UAP, precognitive or otherwise extraordinary interpretation is physically real. Its purpose is to keep unusual reports investigable without confusing uncertainty, symbolism, consensus, audience size, repetition or workflow traces with empirical proof.
